sources: BPIC2018 DATA.xml (doi:10.4121/uuid:3301445f-95e8-4ff0-98a4-901f1f204972): direct payments for German farmers, IACS, profil c/s; workflows are documents with states and actions, some scheduled automatically
data/processed/bpic2018_process_profile.json: activity names, years, case ratios, roles (org:resource)

Payment application.meaning: the farmer's yearly application for direct payments (aid application / payment claim); its decision and payment steps
Payment application.basis: present in 100% of cases every year; subprocess Application has mail income, decide, calculate, begin/finish payment

Entitlement application.meaning: application for the allocation of payment entitlements under the basic payment scheme
Entitlement application.basis: mostly 2015 (first year of the basic payment scheme); actions initialize, decide, calculate; subprocesses Change and Objection

Parcel document.meaning: the farmer's declaration of agricultural parcels (2015 format)
Parcel document.basis: only 2015; replaced in 2016–2017 by Geo parcel document (doctype_replacements in the process profile)

Geo parcel document.meaning: the farmer's geo-spatial declaration of agricultural parcels (2016–2017 format)
Geo parcel document.basis: only 2016–2017; subprocess Declared (parcels declared by the farmer) and Reported

Reference alignment.meaning: cross-check of declared parcels against the reference parcels of the identification system for agricultural parcels
Reference alignment.basis: name only; present in almost every case; mostly automated

Control summary.meaning: summary of the administrative checks and their results for the application
Control summary.basis: name only; present in almost every case

Department control parcels.meaning: parcel checks carried out by the local department

Inspection.meaning: on-the-spot checks, either on site or by remote sensing
Inspection.basis: subprocesses On-Site and Remote; present in ~7% of cases (control sample)

applicant_initiated_note: Mọi event đều do cơ quan ghi (org:resource toàn phía cơ quan); đây là các bước khởi phát bởi việc nông dân nộp hồ sơ. 'Objection' (khiếu nại) cũng có thể do nông dân khởi phát — chưa đưa vào vì chưa chắc.
